name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention: domain 'ai' (battle AI), descriptor 'score_item_use'. Accurately reflects behavior (scores every usable inventory item x every reachable target tile, records best item-use candidate). No Ghidra address residue. Consistent with siblings fd2_ai_score_offensive_spell / fd2_ai_score_physical_attack.
purpose: Enemy AI item-use evaluator: scans every usable inventory item across every reachable target tile and records the single best item-use candidate into the ai_best_item_* result globals.
logic_summary: Resets ai_best_item_score to 0 and pre-loads the job-0 movement-cost table (side-effect: sets the cost-table globals). Reads caster tile (x,y) and mallocs a 400-byte tile-position buffer. n_slots = fd2_count_usable_inventory_slots(caster). For each usable slot: item_id = caster.inventory_slots[slot].item_id; pItem = fd2_get_item_effect_entry(item_id). Skip non-offensive items (pItem[0xD]==0). range_class=pItem[0x10]; a range_class>0x0F (long-range projectile) is clamped to 1 for the reachability precompute. Flood the caster's reachable area via fd2_compute_aoe_targets at the caster pos, collect unmarked tiles into the buffer (n_reachable), then de-obfuscate the tile map. For each reachable tile (cx,cy): pick aoe_arg -- when ctx_flag==0 use (pItem[0x11]==0?1:0), else use pItem[0x11]. If short-range (pItem[0x10]<0x10): n_targets = fd2_compute_aoe_targets(cx,cy,tgt_buf,pItem[0x12],0,aoe_arg); else (long-range): n_targets = fd2_scan_chars_along_line_with_team_filter(cx,cy,tgt_buf,caster_x,caster_y,pItem[0x10]-0x10,0). De-obfuscate tile map. If n_targets>0: score = fd2_score_item_candidate(item_id,n_targets,tgt_buf); if score > ai_best_item_score, update score/target_x/target_y/slot. Finally free the buffer. Underlying routine returns 0 (unused; src declares void).
